# Emoni Digital Solutions (Samuel Emoni)

> Samuel Emoni is a Nairobi-based graphic designer, UI/UX designer and full-stack software engineer. Through Emoni Digital Solutions he designs brand identities and builds custom websites, web applications, SaaS platforms, e-commerce stores and M-Pesa-integrated business software for clients in Kenya, East Africa and across Africa. Design and engineering are treated as one discipline: the same person who designs the brand and interface also builds, deploys and maintains the product, so nothing is lost between a mockup and a live system.

Emoni Digital Solutions is the trading name of Samuel Emoni's design and software practice. Samuel is also co-founder of Monawanka, a multi-sector consultancy (Tech, Agro, Construction, Living, Beauty) operating under the Ubuntu philosophy. He holds a B.Sc. in Applied Computer Science from Chuka University and is pursuing a Master in Computing at Mount Kenya University.

## What Samuel does

### Brand identity and graphic design
- Logo design, brand guidelines, colour and typography systems
- Print and digital collateral: brochures (including trifold), flyers, posters, company profiles, packaging, social media kits
- Event and trade-show materials, exhibitor brochures, signage and pull-up banners
- Business documents with consistent branding: proposals, budgets, forms and editable Word templates with swappable logos
- Tools: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Figma
- Sectors served: hospitality and restaurants, breweries and beverages, healthcare and clinics, engineering, travel, merchandise and corporate branding

### UI/UX design
- Product and interface design for web apps, dashboards, portals and mobile-first websites
- User flows, wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes and design systems in Figma
- Role-based interface design (for example client, staff and admin portals in one product)
- Deliberately solid, brand-led visual language: no template gradients or generic "AI-generated" look, with colour scales, typography pairings and spacing systems defined per client

### Software engineering and web development
- Language-flexible: Samuel works across all major programming languages and frameworks and picks the right tool for each project rather than forcing one stack. This includes JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, C#, C and C++, Go, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Rust, SQL, Bash and more
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Laravel, Spring Boot, .NET, Ruby on Rails
- Mobile and cross-platform: React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, progressive web apps
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Firebase, Supabase, Redis
- Custom websites and web applications; his most frequent stack is React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind CSS
- Backends on Supabase (PostgreSQL, authentication, row-level security, storage, edge functions) or custom APIs in the language the client's team already uses
- Existing codebases: takes over, extends, refactors and integrates with systems already written in any language
- Admin-managed content: categories, filters, pricing tiers, homepage sections and partner logos are stored in the database and edited from an admin dashboard, never hardcoded, so clients update their own sites without a developer
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, role-based access control and audit-friendly data models
- Content management systems, course platforms, booking systems and customer portals
- E-commerce for branded merchandise, quotation-driven ordering and product catalogues

### Business automation and payments
- M-Pesa-integrated systems (STK push, withdrawals, payment reconciliation)
- Workflow automation for lending, microfinance, SACCOs, forex and money-transfer operations
- Reporting dashboards, document generation and automated notifications

### Digital consultancy
- Digital strategy for small and growing businesses
- Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertising proposals, budgets and campaign planning
- Marketing analytics, campaign data audits and descriptive reporting
- Technology advisory through Monawanka for organisations in agriculture, construction, living and beauty sectors

## Selected work
- Putu Travels: luxury coastal travel concierge platform for the Kenyan coast (curated experiences, enquiries and concierge-led booking)
- Protocol Promotions: Nairobi branded merchandise e-commerce platform with product catalogue and quotation workflow
- Flochild Engineering: React and TypeScript corporate website for a Nairobi engineering firm
- Trust Seed: multi-tenant fintech SaaS for microfinance institutions, SACCOs, forex bureaus and money-transfer operators across East Africa
- Domas Little Voices: speech-therapy hub portal with separate client/parent, therapist and admin roles
- Pakistan Pavilion at WHX Nairobi 2026: trifold exhibition brochure profiling eleven exhibitors
- Brand and graphic design for Urban Breweries Kenya, Reigns Clinic and Aruba Arabian Restaurant
- Monawanka: brand, web presence and Meta Ads proposals for a multi-sector consultancy

## Technology stack
- Languages: all major languages, chosen per project (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, C#, Go, Dart, Kotlin, Swift, SQL and others)
- Most-used frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Most-used backend and data: Supabase (PostgreSQL, auth, RLS, storage), REST APIs; also Node.js, Python, PHP and .NET backends
- Payments: M-Pesa (Daraja API)
- Design: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW
- Documents: Word, PDF and print-ready artwork
- Deployment: modern hosting with custom domains (.co.ke and .com), SEO and performance setup

## How Samuel works
- One point of contact from brand strategy to design to code to deployment
- Fixed-scope proposals with clear milestones for websites and systems
- Mobile-first builds, because most Kenyan users reach the web on phones
- Local-market fit: M-Pesa, Kenyan business workflows, Swahili and English audiences
- Remote delivery across Africa, with in-person meetings in Nairobi

## Typical projects and who they are for
- A startup or SME that needs a logo, brand guide and a website that the team can update themselves
- A fintech, SACCO or microfinance institution that needs a secure, multi-role platform with M-Pesa
- A clinic, restaurant, hotel or travel company that needs a brand refresh and a booking-ready website
- An exhibitor or organisation that needs print-ready brochures, banners and event collateral
- A business that wants its manual processes, forms and reports automated

## Location and service area
- Based in Nairobi, Kenya
- Serves Kenya, East Africa and the rest of Africa (remote and in person)

## FAQ
- Does Samuel work with clients outside Kenya? Yes, remotely across Africa and beyond.
- Can clients edit their own website content? Yes. Sites are built with an admin dashboard so text, images, partners and listings are managed without code.
- Does he build M-Pesa payment features? Yes, including STK push and payment tracking.
- Does he handle both design and development? Yes, brand, UI/UX, front end, back end and deployment.
- How do I start a project? Use the [contact page](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/contact) with a short brief on goals, timeline and budget.
